comment: Source is not published. There is no VXWidget::appendContextMenu, which is why the README names this expander and KX as the two without a custom menu. The module is passive: no parameters, no inputs, and everything it sends is computed by the Vektor it is attached to. Polyphony is not claimed for the seven outputs: the manual does not say, and the writing path is inside VektorModule::process rather than in any VX code, so nothing here settles it.
